batch_identity_resolution.why_the_frozen_id_won: the frozen runner's own ``forced_args`` replaces ``--experiment-id`` with the id the confirmation freeze names, so no other id can reach the paid path; the run directory is therefore the frozen one and this audit reads it as it is rather than renaming an artifact that is already written down

mechanism.name: guarantee-preserving line-level omission at K=1
mechanism.rule: the frozen v12 exact duplicate rule, then the v5 lineage evidence-safe retention, then the literal-carrier line elision: every line carrying a registered literal is kept verbatim with one line before and after it, every other line is elided, each maximal omitted run becomes one interval note, and the most recent tool group is kept verbatim

gate_amendment.the_replaced_line: the recalibration's 70 percent first-attempt acceptance line is replaced as the gate by the amendment's four operative clauses; this batch does NOT report itself as having met the 70 percent line
gate_amendment.residual_risk_carried_into_this_batch: at 44 percent first-attempt acceptance about half of the samples were expected to spend the single billed retry; retries are charged to their arm, they add calls to a trajectory, and in earlier batches one asymmetric retry moved a pooled mean by 7 to 21 percentage points

zero_render_failures_zero_truncations_ze.gate_clause: zero render failures, zero truncations, zero dropped fields

primary_criterion.name: as-paired complete provider tokens
primary_criterion.definition: for every (task, repeat) pair: (baseline total provider tokens - plugin total provider tokens) / baseline total provider tokens, where a sample's total is its complete provider input tokens plus its complete provider output tokens, with retries and summary requests charged to the arm they belong to

side_by_side_with_the_v16_sealed_batch.rule: reported side by side and never merged and never pooled: the two batches differ in host configuration, in mechanism and in task set, and this batch's number is citable only under this host configuration and only for the mechanism it names
side_by_side_with_the_v16_sealed_batch.v22_v23_v24_recalibration_numbers: the v22, v23 and v24 recalibration numbers are not citable anywhere in this report and are not used to support it; the recalibration appears only as the amendment's own measurement of the retry, alongside this batch's own retry count

calibration_context.rule: the recalibration's numbers are context for this batch and are never citable and never pooled with it; the amendment's own measurement of five of five retry recoveries comes from that batch and is disclosed as such

cannot_show: it cannot show a general result across hosts, models or configurations: it is one host configuration, one mechanism at one window, and three tasks
it cannot separate the window K's contribution from the mechanism's, because this batch runs at one window only; the dose was measured on the development tasks

it cannot attribute the saving to the mechanism alone where the plugin arm's trajectory differs from the baseline's; that is why the symmetric matched-prefix reading is reported beside the primary one

it cannot establish anything about the two tasks whose defect view is the first read beyond what the literal invariant shows, and for the task whose defect view is the newest tool group that view was never at risk of elision at all
it cannot make the v16 sealed batch's 12.54 percent comparable: the two are reported side by side and are never merged
it cannot rule out that a different sample size would move the pooled mean: five repeats per task is what the freeze pre-registered
it cannot claim the 70 percent first-attempt line the recalibration set and missed: that line was replaced as the gate by the amendment, and this batch reports its own first-attempt rate as measured
it cannot show that the mechanism is safe on content whose only carrier is a line that is not a registered literal: the elision is guarantee-preserving per the literal invariant, not per free text
